lia: Heads-up: ops asked whether we can simplify the new routing rules by standardizing on gRPC inside the cluster. pros/cons?
omar: Pro: proto contracts are explicit, less ad-hoc parsing, faster on the wire with http2. Con: browser clients still need REST -> so we need a translator layer.
tess: Translator could be an edge lambda or an envoy filter. Keep it small: auth + quota + transcode. No business logic.
ryan: Question on quotas: if translator emits quota headers, how do we avoid double-counting when sidecars also talk to rate service? Need an idempotency key or consolidated meter.
anna: We already have x-client-id and x-request-id in the header chain. Suggest we add x-quota-key and a boolean x-quota-claimed to avoid duplicate tokens.
lia: What about telemetry semantics? Console wants per-variant breakouts (canary vs main) and transport breakdown (grpc vs rest-bridge).
omar: we can attach span tags: transport=grpc|rest-bridge, variant=canary-v2. Prom scrape already can capture these as labels.
tess: small example for envoy lua to inject variant tag: 
```lua
function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
  request_handle:headers():replace('x-variant','canary-v2')
end
```
ryan: Rollout UX: add a toggled auto-fallback rule on the route page. If error-rate > 2% for 60s, move 20% to stable. Manual rollback is still needed for config changes.
anna: We need safe actuator API: PATCH /control/routes/:id with {"weights":{"canary-v2":5}}. Use optimistic concurrency (ETag) to avoid races from autoscalers.
lia: CI concern: proto changes. If a proto adds fields non-compatibly, old services will drop unknown fields or crash on required enums. We must enforce 'no required additions' policy and run a proto-compat check in the PR CI.
omar: Agreed. I'll add a check that runs buf check breaking against main. Also emit a deprecation warning if a field is removed.
tess: Edge-case: some internal infra libs still serialize to JSON for logging; ensure we keep a canonical serialization path to avoid subtle field name mismatches.
ryan: For metric alerts, tag by transport label so SRE can quickly tell if it's a gateway issue vs internal handler. Alert: p95 latency increase with transport=rest-bridge triggers a paging rule.
anna: Also add a dashboard card that shows decode-failures by proto-version. If spike -> immediate rollback to rest-bridge for affected tenants.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed: canary-v2 = 10% at 6132100030 :rocket:
ci-bot: proto-compat check passed for buf against origin/main
lia: Nice. Action items: Omar add envoy snippets and header list; Tess scope translator (edge) perf budget; Ryan wire console fallback toggle; Anna add ETag requirement to actuator API. We'll sync in 30m.
omar: I'll open the short RFC and include sample metrics queries.
lia: Thanks team.
